content.value: Integer and Double provide object forms of int and double, allowing numeric values in generic collections. Autoboxing wraps a primitive automatically, and unboxing extracts it. Wrapper objects are immutable. Use intValue() and doubleValue() for explicit extraction. Avoid unboxing null. Integer.MIN_VALUE and Integer.MAX_VALUE mark the finite int range.

next is 8 and total is 20.0. A list declared ArrayList<Integer> can accept add(7) through autoboxing. Incrementing a wrapper reference replaces the reference with a new value; it does not mutate another alias to the original wrapper.
